Name: LP261-75B
Notes: Discovery of rotational spectral modulations in LP261-75B. Likely rotational modulation period = 4.78 ± 0.95 h. Minimum relative amplitude in white light curve (1.1-1.69 µm) = 2.41 ± 0.14%. Gray spectral variations with weak wavelength dependence; no evidence for lower-amplitude modulations in the 1.4 µm water band. Light curve shows seemingly three peaks approximately evenly distributed in rotational phase. Spectral modulations suggest upper atmosphere cloud properties similar to two other mid-L dwarfs of typical infrared colors, but differ from the extremely red L-dwarf WISE0047. Observed as part of Cloud Atlas Treasury program with time-resolved WFC3 grism spectroscopy.
